title: Dynamic SQL with sp_executesql
description: Build a flexible search stored procedure using dynamic SQL.

data.text: Write a stored procedure `sp_SearchEmployees` that dynamically filters by Department and/or minimum Salary only when those parameters are provided.

data.title: SQL Solution
Explanation
data.text: Dynamic SQL builds queries at runtime. sp_executesql is preferred over EXEC() because it supports parameterization (prevents SQL injection and allows plan reuse). The WHERE 1 = 1 trick lets you append AND conditions conditionally without tracking whether a WHERE clause already exists.
